phrases.english: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
phrases.arabic: أنا أستمتع بقراءة الكتب في وقت فراغي.
phrases.pronunciation: Ana astamti' bi qira'at al-kutub fi waqt faraaghee.
phrases.context: Use this to talk about a hobby you do when you have spare time.

phrases.english: My favorite hobby is playing football.
phrases.arabic: هوايتي المفضلة هي لعب كرة القدم.
phrases.pronunciation: Hiwaayati al-mufaddalah hiya la'ib kurat al-qadam.

phrases.english: I like to travel and explore new places.
phrases.pronunciation: Uhibbu as-safar wa istikshaaf al-amakin al-jadeedah.
phrases.context: Describe your passion for visiting different locations.

phrases.english: I spend my weekends hiking in the mountains.
phrases.arabic: أقضي عطلة نهاية الأسبوع في التنزه في الجبال.
phrases.pronunciation: Aqdee 'utlat nihayat al-usbu' fi at-tanazzuh fi al-jibaal.
phrases.context: Share how you typically spend your weekends engaging in an activity.

phrases.english: I love cooking new recipes at home.
phrases.arabic: أحب طبخ وصفات جديدة في المنزل.
phrases.pronunciation: Uhibbu tabkh wasafaat jadeedah fi al-manzil.
phrases.context: Mention an activity you enjoy doing within your own residence.
